tasks.label: Verify Remote MD5 POV
args: $xml='https://dude2714.github.io/zugg/repo_pov/addons.xml'; $md5='https://dude2714.github.io/zugg/repo_pov/addons.xml.md5'; $c=(Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing $xml).Content; $b=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($c); $h=([BitConverter]::ToString([Security.Cryptography.MD5]::Create().ComputeHash($b)) -replace '-','').ToLower(); $remote=(Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing $md5).Content.Trim(); Write-Output ('POV computed='+$h); Write-Output ('POV remote  ='+$remote); if($h -eq $remote){Write-Output 'POV_MD5_MATCH'} else {Write-Output 'POV_MD5_MISMATCH'}
